detaileddescription.para: A software implementation for handling EasyRPG Audio utilizing the AudioDecoder for BGM and AudioSeCache for fast SE playback.

Inheriting implementations have to:
Init the audio system in the constructor (and deinit in destructor)
Start a thread (or a callback) which invokes the Decode function to fill the output buffer and controls access to the audio api of the target platform.
Initialize the "output_format" (must match the format of the hardware)
Implement LockMutex and UnlockMutex. Locking and Unlocking when calling Decode must be done manually.
Implement update function (optional)
